channel_policy: All 16 predefined channels; no data-driven channel selection
current_split: SE003 Train chronological first 12 characters are calibration; last 6 characters are fixed validation
probability_calibration: Training-only character-grouped 3-fold OOF Platt sigmoid; in-sample fallback for one training character; fixed slope L2=0.001
history_scope: All Train characters in SE001 and SE002, including their former within-session validation partitions
reference_scope: All historical characters plus all 12 current calibration characters; never the six validation characters
reference_interpretation: Data-rich reference, not a guaranteed mathematical upper bound; unfair versus smaller k because it uses more current characters
current_k0: No current-only model can be fitted; record unavailable rather than using history or counting it as a measured zero accuracy
test_policy: No Test EDFs are opened. The previous Static experiment was discarded at user request
development_limit: Development validation only. Flash epochs overlap and cluster within characters; flash counts do not imply independent observations. Predeclare EEGNet checkpoint selection as maximizing flash ROC-AUC or minimizing class-balanced flash log-loss, never character accuracy
